owns: explicit current-selection pointers by exact selection scope
does_not_own: semantic authority creation or AuthoritySnapshot adjudication
general empirical comparability or measurement portability
general source composition beyond already-current exact authorities

rules: publication, current-selection, supersession, withdrawal, invalidation, payload deletion, cache state, or carrier location MUST NOT mutate product_ref or semantic_projection_hash
a changed semantic determinant that changes semantic output creates a new product_ref; the prior product remains historical
physical carrier identity and storage locator are not semantic product identity

rules.name: IMMUTABLE_PRODUCT_IDENTITY
rules.holding: Lifecycle actions never rewrite semantic product identity, producer ownership, or historical semantic projection.

rules.name: PUBLICATION_REQUIRES_EXACT_CLOSURE
rules.holding: A product may be PUBLISHED only with exact product identity, producer contract, authority-snapshot closure, determinant-set hash, replay root, and publication authority/receipt. Repository presence alone is insufficient.

rules.name: CURRENT_SELECTION_IS_EXPLICIT
rules.holding: CURRENT_SELECTED exists only through an exact selection receipt keyed by selection_scope_ref. Chronology, filename, branch age, repository order, latest/default/fuzzy selectors, or mere publication never create currentness.

rules.name: SUPERSESSION_IS_RELATIONAL_AND_NONDESTRUCTIVE
rules.holding: Supersession requires an explicit predecessor->successor receipt and exact selection transition. It does not mutate, reinterpret, or erase the predecessor.

rules.name: WITHDRAWAL_IS_NONERASURE
rules.holding: Withdrawal prohibits current serving in its withdrawal scope but preserves product identity, lifecycle receipts, determinant closure, authority snapshots, replay roots, and historical audit/replay obligations.

rules.name: CURRENT_WITHDRAWAL_FAILS_CLOSED
rules.holding: If the current product is withdrawn or invalidated, current selection must atomically move by exact receipt to another already-lawful product or become NO_CURRENT_SELECTION. Implicit fallback is forbidden.

rules.name: HISTORICAL_REPLAY_PINS_HISTORICAL_AUTHORITY
rules.holding: Replay of a historical product resolves the exact historical authority id/version/hash and exact determinants; a superseding current authority may not reinterpret the historical product.

rules.name: DETERMINANT_LOCAL_TRANSITIVE_INVALIDATION
rules.holding: A changed exact determinant invalidates only directly dependent learned products plus their transitive exact product-dependency closure. Unrelated products remain valid. This is candidate generalization of current AuthoritySnapshot determinant-graph mechanics and C08 evidence, not a claim that final C08 reconciliation is complete.

rules.name: AUTHORITY_CHANGE_IS_EXPLICIT_DETERMINANT
rules.holding: Authority promotion/rollback does not silently rewrite products. Exact affected products are invalidated/rebuilt through determinant closure; unaffected products retain identity/currentness.

rules.name: REBUILD_CREATES_NEW_IDENTITY_WHEN_SEMANTICS_CHANGE
rules.holding: A rebuild under changed semantic determinants produces a new exact product identity. A byte-for-byte or semantic-identity-equivalent reconstruction under unchanged determinants may restore materialization without semantic supersession.

rules.name: REBUILD_ELIGIBILITY_REQUIRES_EXACT_INPUTS
rules.holding: Rebuild eligibility requires exact source/upstream availability, authority closure, producer contract, replay/reconstruction instructions, and deterministic or otherwise governed execution evidence. Missing inputs are REBUILD_BLOCKED, never guessed.

rules.name: OPTIONAL_CACHE_IS_NONAUTHORITATIVE
rules.holding: Caches and accelerators may be materialized or dropped without changing semantic validity/currentness when their loss changes performance only. A cache may become a learned product only through separate governed semantic publication.

rules.name: MANDATORY_RETENTION_FLOOR
rules.holding: Product identity, lifecycle event chain, exact authority snapshots, determinant closure, replay/reconstruction roots, required source/upstream refs, and governance/adjudication receipts are mandatory retained capital even when payload bytes are rebuildable.

rules.name: PAYLOAD_GC_REQUIRES_PROOF
rules.holding: Only RECOMPUTABLE_PRODUCT_PAYLOAD may become GC-eligible, and only after exact reconstruction/replay proof, mandatory-retention proof, serving/reconstruction compatibility, and proof that no lifecycle rule requires those payload bytes. Mandatory retained capital is never GC-eligible here.

rules.name: SOURCE_CARRIER_RETIREMENT_OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION
rules.holding: This lifecycle candidate cannot authorize deletion/retirement/cutover of source snapshots or physical carriers. Source-to-C11 CERTIFIED remains source_retirement_authorized=false and cutover_authorized=false. OBL029 remains separate.

rules.name: AUTHORITYSNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE_REMAINS_EXTERNAL
rules.holding: AuthoritySnapshot promotion/rollback/invalidation stays owned by PRE553_AUTH40_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_MAINTENANCE@1.0.0. Learned-product lifecycle consumes exact authority events as determinants; it never reowns semantic authority.

rules.name: PERMISSION_CEILING_PRESERVED
rules.holding: Lifecycle publication/current-selection may narrow availability but cannot widen producer or publication permissions. Currentness is not permission.

rules.name: LOGICAL_SERVICE_PHYSICAL_NEUTRALITY
rules.holding: A current logical learned product may be served by persistent, source-backed reconstructed, or hybrid physical realization only if exact semantic/replay/service equivalence is preserved. Physical presence does not define currentness.

rules.name: APPEND_ONLY_LIFECYCLE_JOURNAL
rules.holding: All lifecycle events are exact, parent-linked, append-only receipts. Rollback/current reselection points to prior lawful products/receipts; history is never rewritten.

rules.name: MISSING_OR_CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE_FAILS_CLOSED
rules.holding: Missing/conflicting product identity, lifecycle authority, semantic authority, determinant closure, replay evidence, or current-selection evidence yields a typed fail-closed state and no implicit publication/currentness/rebuild/GC.

mandatory_conditions: exact product identity and lifecycle history remain retained
exact reconstruction or replay path is proved and named
all historical authority/determinant/replay roots required to reproduce/audit remain retained
current serving contract, if any, can lawfully reconstruct without the payload
no downstream exact dependency requires the physical bytes rather than the logical product
source/carrier dependencies remain retained unless separately retired by competent OBL029 authority
GC attestation is exact and does not alter semantic currentness
never_eligible_here: source/carrier material whose deletion requires OBL029 authority

economics_binding.rule: Compare candidates as equal-obligation cost vectors. Do not weight or aggregate dimensions without separately governed decision authority.
forbidden_credits: assumed cross-source portability or measurement equivalence
optional dormant adaptive/recursive features not activated by workload
legacy migration work when no materially live caller is proved
